title: Security Guards
description: Guard, patrol, or monitor premises to prevent theft, violence, or infractions of rules. May operate x-ray and metal detector equipment.

tasks.text: Lock doors and gates of entrances and exits to secure buildings.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically blocking access to areas

dwas.name: Block physical access to restricted areas.

tasks.text: Patrol industrial or commercial premises to prevent and detect signs of intrusion and ensure security of doors, windows, and gates.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Patrolling properties is embodied mobile work

tasks.text: Respond to medical emergencies by administering basic first aid or by obtaining assistance from paramedics.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — First aid and rescue are hands-on emergency actions

dwas.name: Provide first aid or rescue assistance in emergencies.

tasks.rationale: decision support — Investigation is human fieldwork with judgment

dwas.name: Respond to emergencies to provide assistance.

tasks.text: Circulate among visitors, patrons, or employees to preserve order and protect property.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Physical presence maintaining public order

tasks.text: Monitor and authorize entrance and departure of employees, visitors, and other persons to guard against theft and maintain security of premises.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Managing physical flow of people needs on-site presence

dwas.name: Monitor access or flow of people to prevent problems.
Prevent unauthorized individuals from entering restricted areas.

tasks.text: Write reports of daily activities and irregularities, such as equipment or property damage, theft, presence of unauthorized persons, or unusual occurrences.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Draft operational reports; human tailors and signs off

tasks.text: Warn persons of rule infractions or violations, and apprehend or evict violators from premises, using force when necessary.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Warning individuals is live, relational, accountable

dwas.name: Use weapons or physical force to maintain security.
Warn individuals about rule violations or safety concerns.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Answer telephone calls to take messages, answer questions, and provide information during non-business hours or when switchboard is closed.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Call routing automatable; nuanced calls need human

dwas.name: Answer telephones to direct calls or provide information.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Call police or fire departments in cases of emergency, such as fire or presence of unauthorized persons.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Emergency request requires live accountable action

dwas.name: Request emergency personnel.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Operate detecting devices to screen individuals and prevent passage of prohibited articles into restricted areas.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Surveillance monitoring partly AI, physical setup human

dwas.name: Operate surveillance equipment to detect suspicious or illegal activities.

tasks.text: Inspect and adjust security systems, equipment, or machinery to ensure operational use and to detect evidence of tampering.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Surveillance monitoring partly AI, physical setup human

dwas.name: Inspect equipment to ensure safety or proper functioning.
Operate surveillance equipment to detect suspicious or illegal activities.

tasks.text: Escort or drive motor vehicle to transport individuals to specified locations or to provide personal protection.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Driving vehicles to transport people/equipment

dwas.name: Drive vehicles to transport individuals or equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Monitor and adjust controls that regulate building systems, such as air conditioning, furnace, or boiler.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical HVAC control adjustment; some BMS automation
